name: corpus-mcp
description: MCP server for searching, reading, and citing Calibre book libraries

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/citekey/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.worker:load: tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env src/cli.ts publish --sql worker/.wrangler/replica.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 execute DB --local -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --file worker/.wrangler/replica.sql
scripts.worker:deploy: npm test && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
